motion.purpose: Shared ease-out for dialog, menu, drawer, disclosure, press, and pointer-driven view feedback.
motion.name: ease

motion.purpose: Declared fast duration token; dialog dismissal and press transforms use this duration as literal values.
motion.name: motion-fast

motion.purpose: Declared panel duration token; dialog entrance and drawer transforms use this duration as literal values.
motion.name: motion-panel

motion.purpose: Pointer-triggered dialog entrance through Web Animations; command palette opts out.
motion.name: dialog-enter
motion.value: 220ms; opacity 0 to 1; translateY(8px) scale(.97) to translateY(0) scale(1)

motion.purpose: Pointer-triggered dismissal before removing the dialog.
motion.name: dialog-exit
motion.value: 140ms; opacity 1 to 0; translateY(0) scale(1) to translateY(4px) scale(.98)

motion.purpose: Eligible controls only; excludes virtualized data controls and caption controls, and excludes row actions from press scaling.
motion.name: button-feedback
motion.value: background-color 120ms, border-color 120ms, transform 140ms; pointer active scale(0.97)

motion.purpose: Open menu feedback; branch popover originates at top left, other menus at top right.
motion.name: menu-enter
motion.value: opacity 180ms, transform 180ms; translateY(-4px) scale(0.97) to rest

motion.name: drawer
motion.value: opacity 180ms, transform 220ms, display 220ms allow-discrete; translateY(12px) to rest

motion.purpose: File-group disclosure preserves a readable relationship between heading and contents.
motion.name: file-group

motion.purpose: Pointer-triggered Changes, History, and collection entrances; keyboard navigation is immediate.
motion.name: pointer-view-enter

motion.purpose: Thumb movement on the Settings switch.
motion.name: setting-toggle

motion.purpose: Loading feedback while interface motion is enabled.
motion.name: spinner

motion.purpose: Persistent Settings switch or reduced-motion preference disables CSS motion and the spinner. Dialog Web Animations check the same conditions. Keyboard input bypasses dialog, menu, drawer, disclosure, and view entrance motion.
motion.name: motion-off
motion.value: animation: none !important; transition: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important

breakpoints.name: compact-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width: tighter surrounding spacing, icon-only toolbar actions, and narrower branch picker; persisted list widths remain clamped to available space.

breakpoints.name: narrow-desktop
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum width: icon sidebar and stacked history with a 45% list row (200px minimum), hiding the vertical resize separator; Changes retain their resizable split.

breakpoints.name: short-window
breakpoints.purpose: Maximum height: reduce sidebar secondary content and grouping space.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact primary action with theme-bound colors and visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-primary { font: 600 13px -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 28px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: var(--accent, #255fc7); color: var(--accent-ink, #fff); cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #3275d6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; } :host-context([data-motion='on']) .ds-primary { transition: background-color 120ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), border-color 120ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)), transform 140ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)); } :host-context([data-motion='on'][data-input='pointer']) .ds-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-primary { transition: none !important; transform: none !important; } }

narrative.northStar: Mac-inspired craft with native Windows behavior
narrative.overview: Gik combines Mac-inspired craft with Windows behavior: locally bundled Inter Variable, compact neutral panels, precise alignment, and integrated themeable Windows caption controls. F11 hides the entire toolbar. A continuous bordered sheet keeps repository state readable. Light and dark themes share the same topology and follow the OS by default. Purposeful motion is enabled by default on occasional pointer-driven surfaces, with a persistent Settings switch and reduced-motion override.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral frame around a bordered content sheet.
Local Inter Variable on Windows with compact typography and readable metadata.
Blue selection and semantic Git state, with a separate five-color graph palette for branch continuity.
Integrated Windows caption controls and fullscreen toolbar hiding.
Purposeful default motion on occasional surfaces; immediate keyboard navigation and data.
Resizable Changes and History panes with independently persisted widths, pointer dragging, and keyboard resizing.
Roomier dialog forms and a searchable branch popover.
dos: Do keep caption controls themeable while preserving native Windows window actions, shortcuts, focus, and resizing behavior.
Do use paired semantic tokens across light and dark themes.
Do retain keyboard access, visible focus, forced colors, reduced motion, and non-color state indicators.
Do honor the persistent motion switch and reduced-motion preference while keeping keyboard navigation and data immediate.
donts: Don't use code fonts for ordinary interface text.
Don't add decorative color, panel shadows, raster illustrations, or oversized display typography to the workbench.
Don't animate keyboard selection or navigation.
Don't turn the integrated Windows caption controls into imitation macOS traffic lights.
